timestamp_order_check.note: Same-launch kernel endpoint overlap is reported, not used as proof of a race or physical concurrency. Unique graph ownership, device/context/stream, strictly increasing starts/ends, exact compute sequence/dispatch and strict staging/replay boundaries remain checked. Source-frozen capture and exact smoke checks are separate correctness requirements; raw timestamps are unchanged.

rng_replay_prologue.note: The pinned replay_prologue skips state fills when wholegraph_increment is zero; attention dropout is zero and capture RNG is checked.

attention_graph.graph_correlation_policy: Every graph node must share the unique owning cudaGraphLaunch CUPTI correlation. Missing association fails validation; no temporal matching fallback.
attention_graph.limitation: Graph work, staging and owned-output copies are included. Profile intervals overlap and are perturbed; none is an unprofiled step saving.
